name: Ama Hayashi
role: Social engineering and negotiation specialist — face
location: Ashfield — former residential district, half-burned, now squatter territory, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Ama Hayashi is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 37, her face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and she has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, she worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. She works as a face out of Ashfield, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Ama Hayashi describe her as a precision instrument — point her at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, profane, and vivid. Speaks in images — everything is a metaphor for violence or weather.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "People want to trust someone. I just make sure that someone is me."
"The hardest lock to pick is between someone's ears."
"I don't lie. I tell a better version of the truth."

story_hooks: A dead drop Fatoumata Borg-Agyeman maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
A Tier 4 executive offers Fatoumata Borg-Agyeman a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A corporate black site Fatoumata Borg-Agyeman once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
narrative_function: Fatoumata Borg-Agyeman is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation. Hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown

physical_description.heritage: East Asian (39%) / Sub-Saharan African (34.5%) / South Asian (26.5%) — a striking diaspora blend creating phenotypic richness. High, prominent cheekbones and angular bone structure from East Asian ancestry; warm, deep undertones from Sub-Saharan African heritage; refined facial proportions and eye shape influenced by South Asian genetics. The combination produces a commanding presence with layered complexity across her features.
physical_description.build: Stocky and densely muscled — broad shoulders, thick forearms, compact center of gravity. Built for leverage and power absorption rather than speed. Functional musculature, no wasted frame.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with subtle auburn undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Tight braids pulled back into a practical crown braid, secured with matte black fasteners
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown — unaugmented but with faint scarring at the inner corners suggesting past orbital trauma
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich deep brown complexion with warm golden undertones — a result of East Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and South Asian ancestry blending. Sun-damaged from outdoor work and industrial exposure, creating uneven patina across forearms and shoulders.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, angular jaw with pronounced cheekbones reflecting East Asian structure; broad across the face with South Asian refinement and Sub-Saharan African depth. A scar bisects her left eyebrow horizontally. Her expression defaults to neutral, professionally unremarkable. Calloused knuckles, cracked palms from pre-augmentation labor. Subtle epicanthal fold from East Asian heritage, contributing to the intensity of her gaze.
distinguishing_marks: Horizontal scar across left eyebrow, 3cm long, pale and old
Burn scar on inside of right wrist (chemical splash, faded to white), 4cm diameter
Tattoo on left forearm: three stacked circles (Borg family sigil) in black ink, simple and geometric
Hairline fracture scar along right temple, barely visible unless light hits it at an angle
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome reflex wiring visible at wrists and neck — bright silver conduits threading under dark skin, subdermally routed but intentionally left exposed. Hydraulic joint housings visible at elbows (gunmetal finish) and knees (covered but bulging slightly under fitted clothing). No attempt at concealment — the chrome is part of her working appearance.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, controlled, always balanced. She stands with weight centered, ready to shift instantly. Walks with precision, each step deliberate. When relaxed (rare), slight forward lean. In negotiation or threat, she goes perfectly still — predatory stillness, not nervous tension.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian. Reinforced cargo pants (synthetic weave, dark grey, multiple zippered pockets), fitted black long-sleeve shirt (thermal-resistant material, loose enough to hide gear), steel-toed boots (practical, not fashionable). Over it: a worn synthetic leather jacket (charcoal, no logos, deliberately unmarked) with internal holsters. Minimal jewelry — matte black watch (military-grade chronometer, visible wear). No corporate branding, no gang colors. Everything functional, everything durable, nothing that draws unnecessary attention when she's off the clock.
